gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anek-odia: Capture Smallz stomps in with raw, tactical energy and big-bodied lowercase letters that fill every line it touches. Anek Odia keeps its rounds open and its capitals barely taller than lowercase.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-anuphan: Big-bodied lowercase letters give Capture Smallz a raw, tactical swagger that pushes hard against the page. Anuphan, a sans-serif with big round bowls, feels clean and tidy beside it.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-arimo: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz lays down big-bodied lowercase letters with real attitude. Arimo, sans-serif with a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, works nicely at modest sizes.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-duru-sans: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase letters that crowd the line. Duru Sans keeps wide openings on small letters, so paragraphs of text move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-fresca: Raw, chunky lowercase leads the way, loud and unpolished. Capture Smallz sets that tactical swagger against Fresca, whose plain sans outline never thins and keeps its counters open to the outside.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-funnel-sans: Funnel Sans keeps strokes consistent from stem to curve. Capture Smallz does best at raw, big-bodied lowercase swagger, while Funnel Sans does best at tight, tidy lines with an open e.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a tall band of letters under short stalks. Capture Smallz brings raw, big-bodied lowercase up front, while the sans-serif text keeps reading smooth across many lines, each e wide-eyed.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-geist: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz hits with big-bodied lowercase that makes every word feel stamped onto the line. Geist, plain sans with a level beat, can sit at modest size.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-golos-text: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a raw, tactical stomp that dominates any line it lands on. Golos Text, plain sans with a full x-height, keeps text friendly and fluid.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-hind-madura: Capture Smallz is raw, tactical, and built from big-bodied lowercase. Hind Madurai, a sans with flat stroke weight and s curves open at both ends, lets text flow along without a snag.
